<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template for the given molecule, I will search the template catalog for reactions that form a 6‑6 bond, which is characteristic of a Diels‑Alder cycloaddition. This should return templates that, when applied in reverse, break the newly formed bonds and give the diene and dienophile precursors. I’ll request up to 10 results.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O", "bonds_formed": ["6-6"], "limit": 10}</action_input>
